parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token that ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value on your client. The token must contain only ASCII characters and be no more than 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default value: en.

parameters.name: NewResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the destination resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the zone.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pvtz move-resource-group --lang en --resource-id df2d03865266bd9842306db586d40000 --new-resource-group-id rg-aekz2qj7awz0000 --client-token 21079fa016944979537637959d09bc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun pvtz MoveResourceGroup --region cn-hangzhou --NewResourceGroupId 'rg-aekz2qj7awz0000' --ResourceId df2d03865266bd9842306db586d40000 --Lang en --ClientToken 21079fa016944979537637959d09bc
